desc: reg_lambda = 0.03, 2 convolutional layers  -> the paper's Table 4.
arm = dgn  WITH temporal relation regularisation, which is part of the
method; 'dgn_r' is the paper's own ablation without it.
graph = overlap  two travellers are neighbours when their OD pairs'
route sets share a link AND their trips are co-present. That is the
coupling graph; 'copresence' and 'od' are the cheaper alternatives.
Needs the generated route table -- pass --routes if it is not found.
Weights are SHARED across agents, as in the paper: the graph convolution
normalize_target = true  the regression target is standardised.
Without it URBs -1000 reward scale drives the features to ~50,
the attention logits are quadratic in that, and every softmax
saturates into a hard argmax -- the graph convolution stops
being one. Measured; see CHECKLIST_dgn.md item SCALE-1.
